ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including how the alleged fraudsters obtained and laundered the funds
questions: How did the alleged fraudsters obtain the funds?
How did they launder the money?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover additional individuals or organizations involved in the scheme and determine the full extent of the alleged fraud.
